---
title: "Research"
---

My research focuses on the design and analysis of algorithms for structured optimization problems, particularly when classical smoothness or convexity assumptions are too restrictive.

## High-order envelopes and proximal methods

A central direction of my work studies nonquadratic regularization of order \(p>1\) and the resulting high-order proximal mappings and envelope functions. This includes the high-order Moreau envelope, high-order forward-backward envelope, their regularity properties, and algorithms built around them.

## Nonsmooth and nonconvex optimization

I am interested in convergence mechanisms for problems with nonsmooth or nonconvex geometry, including prox-regularity, weak smoothness, Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz inequalities, generalized descent conditions, inexact proximal oracles, and majorization-minimization methods.

## Optimization and machine learning

I also study optimization structures arising in machine learning and data science, including robust learning, recommender systems, Bayesian sampling, inverse problems, and low-rank recovery. My goal is to connect mathematical structure with algorithms that remain useful computationally.

## Current research project

At the University of Antwerp, my research project concerns the **evaluation complexity of non-Euclidean optimization methods**, including first-, second-, and high-order algorithms for structured nonsmooth and nonconvex problems and applications in machine learning, data science, signal processing, and related areas.
